contract.scaling: parent-only response-equal beta-weighted mean/SD, frozen for all resamples; zero SD uses scale 1
contract.fixed_effects: response intercepts removed by weighted centering; exact joint categorical (e,r,n)

bootstrap.cluster_order: sorted original UTF-8 record_id; anchors ascending within response

acceleration.method: global SVD whitening, response cross-products, reconstructed-design SVD
acceleration.fallback: direct weighted-design SVD with the identical rank rule

contract.confidence_intervals: primary full-model Y only; secondary fits descriptive
contract.influence_policy: report all LOO failures and energy concentration; no invented dominance cutoff

coverage.scope: Per-response selected diagnostic anchors; not historical training allocation pools

useful_repair.interpretation: Descriptive full-specification linear-probability coefficient; not a selection criterion

prefix_damaged.interpretation: Descriptive full-specification linear-probability coefficient; not a selection criterion

raw_association.weighting: equal response total; beta within origin HIGH

interpretation: Conditional association in one retained training-buffer transition; no weight-allocation or serving causal effect
